name: silver
lore_descriptor: moon-bright, slightly heavier than it should be
first_pickup_chronicle: Silver. The dead will hate this. The good news is, the dungeon has plenty of them.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 0.90, weight_mult 1.05, effective_against undead+lycanthrope (T2 specialty). Value is in effective_against, not raw damage. The first 'situational' material — players will swap to silver for undead floors.
